intro: Items still outside the app before Mainnet. Sepolia testing does not require them. Privacy on-chain comes from the circuits; Ceremony/audit are about trust and soundness for real funds.

items.title: Trusted Ceremony (MPC)
items.summary: Replace LOCAL TRUSTED proving keys with multi-party finals under packages/circuits/ceremony/finals/. Needed before Mainnet with user funds — not required for Sepolia.

items.title: Fill ceremony_params.json
items.summary: Copy the template and set coordinatorContact + attestationPublishWhere (keep status draft until you recruit). Does not start the MPC by itself.
items.when: When you are ready to organize contributors

items.title: External security audit
items.summary: Engage a ZK + EVM privacy auditor. Send a frozen commit, four product circuits, ShieldedPool, and honest key status (LOCAL TRUSTED vs ceremony-final).
items.when: Before treating the system as production-ready
